steps.text: OptimCE helps you share energy within an energy community. You already belong to a community: its card, under **"My communities"**, shows the role you hold there.
steps.title: Welcome to OptimCE

steps.text: The top of the page lists what needs an action from you, across all your communities: an invitation to accept, a detail missing from your record, unread notifications. When it reads "Nothing needs you right now. Everything is in order.", there is nothing to do.
steps.title: What needs you

steps.text: This button takes you into your community: its dashboard and its menus. The first time, a tour for your role will show you around.

Further down, the home page gathers, for all your communities at once, **"My energy"**, **"My documents"**, **"My invoices to pay"** and **"What has been filed about me"**. You do not need to open each community to see them.
steps.title: Everything about you

steps.text: The sidebar's **"Profile"** section is always there: home, profile, invitations, your communities and the public communities.
steps.title: Your profile

steps.text: Tap the **menu icon ☰** to open the navigation.
The menu's **"Profile"** section holds the home page, your profile, your invitations, your communities and the public communities.
steps.title: Your profile

steps.text: When another community invites you, or you are asked to help run yours, the invitation lands here — the **"Members"** tab to become a member, **"Manager"** to help run it — and your home page points it out.
steps.title: Your invitations

steps.text: At the bottom of the sidebar, **"User guide"** opens the help, at any time and from any page. Click it.
steps.title: Need help?

steps.text: Tap the **menu icon ☰** to open the navigation.
At the bottom of the menu, **"User guide"** opens the help, at any time and from any page. Tap it.
steps.title: Need help?

steps.text: **"Open the online user guide"** opens the guide in a new tab: every task in the application is described there step by step, with screenshots, and can also be played as an animation.
steps.title: The online guide

steps.text: **"Guided tours"** lists tours like this one: they show you a task right inside the application. You will find the ones for your role in your community here; start one again whenever you need it. Close this window to get started.
steps.title: Guided tours
